scenarios.description: Fresh approved persistent install, permissions, host restart and plugin discovery
scenarios.evidence: Fresh install on 0.1.5 (owner, 2026-10-19, work/acceptance/RUNBOOK-c1-fresh-0.1.5.md): prepare-c1-fresh-0.1.5.sh verified the archive sha256 7a717178…a417, uninstalled the plugin and removed the marketplace, moved the data directory and the extracted marketplace aside (not deleted), extracted the archive anew; all pre-checks reported none. In Claude Code 2.1.303: /plugin marketplace add <local extracted dir> and /plugin install editor-platform@editor-platform-local, user scope chosen, no --plugin-dir; the install panel's MCP server/permission display was as expected (owner). After /exit and restart, in a new conversation: /plugin showed editor-platform@editor-platform-local 0.1.5, user scope, enabled; /mcp showed plugin:editor-platform:editor-platform connected (owner); claude plugin list confirms 0.1.5/user/enabled. The skill prompt (/editor-platform:editor-platform, three fictional service slides with figures) ran list_editors, get_editor_guide(slide), create_deck with native content (3 slides: step diagram of shapes/arrows, bar chart + KPI cards, table + chevron roadmap; revision 1) and open_editor (launch_unconfirmed). The data directory EditorPlatform/ClaudeCode was newly created on first use and held only that deck. The owner opened the deck from Saved artifacts in the Windows Edge Editor; three slides and figures displayed. Gap: no per-tool permission prompt was shown on the first tool calls because the session ran in Claude Code auto mode; the first-use permission dialog for MCP tools was therefore not observed on 0.1.5.
